name: live-indicator
title: LiveIndicator
description: Pink dot and label that marks a real-time stream. Not a status.

a11y.pattern: Static <span> with a decorative dot and visible label
aria: paused adds the visible word "paused" and stops the dot
Dot pulse stops under reduced motion
a11y.notes: Pair it with a Pause control for streams (RGAA 13.8). Never show it for a finished result.
